entries.topicDescription: Build variants, product flavors, and custom Gradle tasks for Android projects.

tips.title: Product flavors and build types combine to form every build variant
tips.content:
Build types (debug/release) alone only control things like
debuggability and minification, while separate concerns like
'which backend environment' or 'which app tier' (free vs paid) don't fit
naturally into that same axis.

Product flavors add a second, independent axis — Gradle automatically
combines every flavor with every build type to produce the full variant
matrix (e.g. freeDebug, freeRelease, paidDebug, paidRelease), each with
its own source set for flavor-specific code, resources, and
configuration.
